hero.description: No more juggling a dozen separate apps. VedaMatch brings together dating, community, practice, and marketplace for people who live in goodness.

services.title: One account — eight services
services.subtitle: VedaMatch is more than dating. It's an ecosystem for a life in goodness: practice, knowledge, community and conscious connections in one place.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to conscious connections and community

profile.title: Create a profile
profile.description: Tell us about yourself, your interests, your values and what you are looking for in relationships and communication.

matches.title: Find your matches
matches.description: The system analyses your data and suggests people with similar interests and intentions.

chat.title: Start talking

features.title: What Union offers
features.subtitle: The platform's flagship service — conscious dating and bringing like-minded people together

matching.title: Conscious matching
matching.description: The system compares your intentions, interests and values to find truly compatible people.

stages.title: Spiritual stages
stages.description: We take your stage on the path into account — from seeker to devotee — for more precise recommendations.

connections.title: Every kind of connection
connections.description: Family, friendship, service, projects or spiritual fellowship — choose what you need.

privacy.title: Privacy under your control
privacy.description: You decide what others see. Contacts and location open only after mutual consent.

search.title: Smart search
search.description: Filter by city, radius, interests and the type of relationship you are looking for.

chat.title: Built-in chat
chat.description: Talk to your matches right in the app — no need to switch to messengers.

rules.title: Market rules
rules.intro: The Market is a place for devotees. A few simple rules apply here.
rules.prohibited1: Meat, fish, eggs and anything containing them
rules.prohibited3: Items made of animal leather or fur
rules.prohibited4: Goods and services prohibited by law
rules.prohibited5: Other people goods without the owner consent
rules.general1: State the real price and condition
rules.general2: Answer your buyers — silence is worse than a refusal
rules.general3: Payment and delivery are arranged directly with the seller: the Market processes no payments and acts as no intermediary
rules.general4: Reports about listings are reviewed by the administration
rules.moderation: Listings are published immediately. The administration may hide a listing or close a shop if the rules are broken.
